Frequently Asked Questions

Is QAU better than University of Punjab?

Both Quaid-i-Azam University and University of the Punjab are HEC-recognized universities. QAU is public (est. 1967) in Islamabad, while University of Punjab is public (est. 1882) in Lahore / Gujranwala / Jhelum / Khanspur. The better choice depends on your field, budget, and merit — compare the details above.

What is the fee difference between QAU and University of Punjab?

QAU's fee is approximately Rs. 60–80K/sem per semester, while University of Punjab's is Rs. 25–45K/sem. See the full comparison above.

What is the merit for QAU and University of Punjab?

QAU: Merit on academic record (≈30% Matric + 70% HSSC) with strict provincial/regional quotas. LLB needs LAT; MPhil/PhD need GAT/subject test + interview.. University of Punjab: ~75% Academic Record (Inter/Matric) + 25% PU Admission Test. Engineering: ECAT. Pharmacy/Medical: MDCAT..
